Of the rest, 7 are exploratory probes run once by qa-runner (`manual-agent`) and 2 are `skip` with a reason. Size M (override of the defect cap), cap 10: 5 automate rows are planned; if the owner's answers turn probes into checks, up to 4 more could earn code (TS-6, TS-11, TS-12 and TS-10 branch b), still within 10.
